heard: Twelve spies went up through the edge of land They came to Hebron, a fortified town They saw Ahime, Shishai, and Elmite Descendants of Anak, giants in the place We seem like grasshoppers in our own eyes And so we seem to them, they said The people were strong, the city so large Fear filled the hearts of Israel's band Caleb quieted the people before Moses We should go up and take possession now For we are well able to do it, he declared Though the men with him said, no, we cannot fight We seem like grasshoppers In our own eyes And so we seem to know
